derivation: from a compound of G3326 (μετά) and G3593 (ὁδεύω) (compare "method");

occurrences.text: That we henceforth be no more children, tossed to and fro, and carried about with every wind of doctrine, by the sleight of men, and cunning craftiness, whereby they lie in wait to deceive;
Put on the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
